python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import yaml

root = Path('"'"'/sandbox/work'"'"')
phase = root / '"'"'.planning/phases/106-command-center-polish'"'"'
plans = sorted(phase.glob('"'"'*-PLAN.md'"'"'))
assert [p.name for p in plans] == [f'"'"'106-{i:02d}-PLAN.md'"'"' for i in range(1, 6)]
metadata = {}
for p in plans:
    text = p.read_text()
    assert text.startswith('"'"'---\n'"'"'), p
    data = yaml.safe_load(text.split('"'"'---'"'"', 2)[1])
    number = int(data['"'"'plan'"'"'])
    assert int(data['"'"'wave'"'"']) == (1 if number in (1, 2, 4) else 2), p
    for key in ('"'"'phase'"'"', '"'"'type'"'"', '"'"'depends_on'"'"', '"'"'files_modified'"'"', '"'"'autonomous'"'"', '"'"'requirements'"'"', '"'"'must_haves'"'"'):
        assert key in data, (p, key)
    assert data['"'"'files_modified'"'"'], p
    for tag in ('"'"'objective'"'"', '"'"'tasks'"'"', '"'"'verification'"'"', '"'"'success_criteria'"'"', '"'"'threat_model'"'"'):
        assert f'"'"'<{tag}>'"'"' in text, (p, tag)
    tasks = re.findall(r'"'"'<task\b[^>]*>(.*?)</task>'"'"', text, re.S)
    assert tasks, p
    for task in tasks:
        for tag in ('"'"'read_first'"'"', '"'"'files'"'"', '"'"'action'"'"', '"'"'acceptance_criteria'"'"', '"'"'verify'"'"'):
            assert f'"'"'<{tag}>'"'"' in task, (p, tag)
    commands = re.findall(r'"'"'<automated>(.*?)</automated>'"'"', text, re.S)
    failures = re.findall(r'"'"'<fails_when>(.*?)</fails_when>'"'"', text, re.S)
    assert commands and len(commands) == len(failures), (p, len(commands), len(failures))
    assert '"'"'ad3942b'"'"' in text and '"'"'FAIL'"'"' in text and '"'"'PASS'"'"' in text, p
    assert all(word in text for word in ('"'"'orchestrate'"'"', '"'"'workflowz'"'"', '"'"'ultrathink'"'"')), p
    if number != 1:
        assert '"'"'registry.npmjs.org'"'"' in text, p
    metadata[number] = data
for wave in (1, 2):
    owners = {}
    for number, data in metadata.items():
        if int(data['"'"'wave'"'"']) != wave:
            continue
        for filename in data['"'"'files_modified'"'"']:
            assert filename not in owners, (wave, filename, owners.get(filename), number)
            owners[filename] = number
terminal = '"'"'omega_prime/dashboard/frontend/src/components/TerminalPanel.tsx'"'"'
assert terminal not in metadata[4]['"'"'files_modified'"'"']
assert terminal in metadata[5]['"'"'files_modified'"'"']
assert (phase/'"'"'106-UPLIFT.xml'"'"').read_bytes() == Path('"'"'/sandbox/home/refs/106-UPLIFT.xml'"'"').read_bytes()
assert (phase/'"'"'106-ADDENDUM-model-buckets.md'"'"').read_bytes() == Path('"'"'/sandbox/home/refs/ADDENDUM-model-buckets.md'"'"').read_bytes()
contract = ET.parse(phase/'"'"'106-UPLIFT.xml'"'"').getroot()
assert len(contract.findall('"'"'./ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA/ITEM'"'"')) == 9
all_text = '"'"'\n'"'"'.join(p.read_text() for p in plans)
for i in range(1, 10):
    assert f'"'"'AC{i}'"'"' in all_text, i
roadmap = (root/'"'"'.planning/ROADMAP.md'"'"').read_text()
assert roadmap.index('"'"'### Phase 106: Command Center polish'"'"') > roadmap.index('"'"'### Phase 105: Omega Prime Command Center'"'"')
for p in plans:
    assert p.name in roadmap
print('"'"'PASS: five plans; wave1 01/02/04, wave2 03/05; file-disjoint wave ownership; task/verify structure; terminal custody; exact references; AC1–AC9; roadmap placement'"'"')

assert (phase/'"'"'106-PLAN-CHECK.md'"'"').is_file()
print('"'"'PASS: independent checker report present'"'"')
'
